2607.24268.title: Accuracy Hides How Language Models Fail: Measuring Failure States Under Matched Output Budgets
2607.24268.paper_summary: Language-model benchmarks collapse two distinct measurement questions into a single accuracy score: whether a response reached an evaluable state, and whether its answer was judged correct. We introduce a two-layer evaluation framework that separates scorer-independent execution evidence, including termination, answer exposure, parseability, and completion length, from scorer-dependent correctness. Across 2,550 outputs from five fixed Qwen and DeepSeek configurations on MATH and ARC-Challenge, matched 2,048-token limits produce sharply different execution mixtures: 49 of 450 Qwen MATH outputs terminate without a final answer, compared with 5 of 300 DeepSeek MATH outputs and none of the 750 ARC outputs. Among the same 300 DeepSeek MATH question-model pairs, no missing-final length termination is observed at 8,192 tokens. A coverage-audited targeted verification study further shows that candidate-selection and aggregation policies can substantially alter comparative accuracy estimates. These results demonstrate that accuracy conflates execution case mix with verification policy. Evaluations of test-time methods should therefore report pre-intervention execution states, verification coverage, and scorer provenance alongside accuracy.
2607.24268.paper_summary_zh: 語言模型基準將兩個不同的測量問題合併為一個單一的準確度分數：一個是回應是否達到可評估的狀態，另一個是其答案是否被判斷為正確。我們引入了一個兩層評估框架，將與評分者無關的執行證據（包括終止、答案曝光、可解析性和完成長度）與依賴於評分者的正確性分開。在來自五個固定 Qwen 和 DeepSeek 配置的 2,550 個輸出中，匹配的 2,048 令牌限制產生了截然不同的執行混合：在 450 個 Qwen MATH 輸出中，有 49 個在沒有最終答案的情況下終止，而在 300 個 DeepSeek MATH 輸出中則有 5 個，750 個 ARC 輸出中則沒有。在同樣的 300 個 DeepSeek MATH 問題-模型對中，未觀察到在 8,192 令牌時缺失最終長度的終止。一項經過覆蓋審核的目標驗證研究進一步顯示，候選選擇和聚合政策可以顯著改變比較準確度的估計。這些結果表明，準確度將執行案例混合與驗證政策混淆。因此，測試時間方法的評估應報告干預前的執行狀態、驗證覆蓋率和評分者來源，並與準確度一起報告。
2607.24268.author: Zongyou Yang et.al.
